Then validate release-matched hashes/licenses/assets and balanced SDXL Server command; execute required image-quality and Server performance/LoadGen validity stages; preserve quality artifacts/logs, detail/summary, throughput/latency and telemetry; restore state and compare only with the same-release matched SDXL Server reference.
